name: Copy QC JPEG Images & Purge Old Folders
notes: Copies .jpeg QC images from Z:\ into per-instrument subfolders under Y:\temporary_files\JO\qc_images (ECL1, LUM1, LUM2, QEX2, QEX3). Also removes source directories on Z:\ older than 7 days. Requires Z:\ and Y:\ network drives to be mounted. The .ps1 is called directly - no need for the .bat launcher wrapper.
